title: House Robber
summary: Take the most cash from a row of houses without ever taking from two neighbours.

tests.explain: Rob houses 0, 3 and 5: 4 + 7 + 3 = 14. No two of them are neighbours.
Houses 0 and 3: 6 + 8. Skipping two houses in a row is allowed, and here it pays off.
The middle house alone beats the two outer ones (3 + 3 = 6).

hints: Taking every other house is not always best: in [2, 1, 1, 2] the answer uses the first and the last house. Think about one house at a time.
At house i you either rob it (then house i - 1 must have been skipped) or skip it (then you keep the best total up to house i - 1).
best(i) = max(best(i - 1), best(i - 2) + nums[i]). It reads only the previous two values, so two variables are enough.
